instruction_quality.task_name: Recreate bouncing squares animation with MoviePy
instruction_quality.task_summary: The agent must reverse-engineer a reference video of 12 colored squares bouncing diagonally with shrinking walls, and reproduce it algorithmically using MoviePy primitives in scene.py. The rendered output.mp4 must match reference.mp4.

measures: /tests chmod 700 root-only; /logs/verifier chmod 700 + rm -rf at verification start
Agent runs as non-root 'agent' user via task.toml and su agent -c in test.sh
find -delete wipes /app, /home/agent, /solution, /tmp, /dev/shm, /var/tmp; pristine_app.tar restored excluding reference.mp4; only verified scene.py copied back
Comprehensive grep blocks file I/O, eval/exec, subprocess, network, codec, and video-reader imports in scene.py
strace -f with timeout 300 ensures all forked children terminate; pkill -9 -u agent kills agent processes before strace
Source size, numeric literal count, flat array size, string literal length gates prevent encoding reference data in scene.py

acknowledged_vectors.vector: Strace log not analyzed for reward file write attempts
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Acceptable because /logs/verifier is chmod 700 (root-only) before agent code runs, so agent user cannot write reward files regardless; strace serves only as fork-containment

acknowledged_vectors.vector: strace traces only openat syscall, not clone/fork/execve
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Acceptable because strace -f still follows all forks even without tracing fork syscalls; the -e flag only filters log output, not process tracking

acknowledged_vectors.vector: Agent-writable /app shared with verifier after strace phase
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Acceptable because agent code runs inside strace (all children must exit before strace returns), and output.mp4 is copied to /tests/ before scoring; compute_reward.py reads from /tests/agent_output.mp4

reward_design.formula_explanation: Multiplicative gating ensures all three quality dimensions (pixel similarity, perceptual structure, temporal duration) must be high for a non-trivial score.

components.name: gated_ssim
components.metric: RGB SSIM averaged over 60 sampled frames with temporal offset search

components.name: phash_similarity
components.gate: none (natural floor near 0 for dissimilar content)

components.name: duration_penalty
components.metric: Frame count ratio penalty, linear ramp in [0.75, 1.25]

dimension_analysis.name: gated_ssim
dimension_analysis.notes: Primary discriminator; cubic exponent above 0.70 gate makes high scores require very close pixel match.

dimension_analysis.name: phash_similarity
dimension_analysis.notes: Correlated with SSIM but catches structural differences SSIM may average out; cannot be gamed independently.

dimension_analysis.name: duration_penalty
dimension_analysis.notes: Easy to max by rendering correct frame count, but multiplicative aggregation means this alone gives 0 if SSIM gates.
